authentication.note: The hosted door requires a free APEX sign-in (OAuth 2.0). An anonymous call returns HTTP 401 with a WWW-Authenticate resource-metadata pointer. The npm door (npx -y apex-psi-mcp) requires no account at all. Verification is free through both doors and is never a paid tier.

description: APEX PSI is an open evidence protocol (Proof of Stateful Integrity): a commit-and-challenge sealing service for records, decisions and agent runs. This card describes the hosted notary door. A seal records that a record was made at a stated time and has not changed since; it never records that the record's contents are true. Verification is offline-capable and free forever with the MIT-licensed verifier packages (apex-psi-verifier / psi-verifier, pin 1.7.0). The protocol is not zero-knowledge and is not a proof of truth.
name: APEX PSI Notary

oauth2.description: OAuth 2.0 via the APEX sign-in. Authorization server: https://qhtntebpcribjiwrdtdd.supabase.co/auth/v1 — metadata published at https://ai-governance-standard.com/.well-known/oauth-authorization-server

skills.description: Seal a record, decision or agent-run step to the append-only APEX PSI ledger and receive a receipt (receipt_id, timestamp, Merkle position, signatures). Hosted tool: seal. npm tool: seal. The seal covers the record's SHA-256 hash; the content itself never leaves the caller.
examples: Seal this decision payload and return the receipt
skills.name: Seal a record

skills.description: Verify a record against the ledger: re-compute its SHA-256 hash and check that a matching sealed record exists and is unchanged. Hosted tool: verify_hash. npm tool: verify. Also available offline with apex-psi-verifier / psi-verifier 1.7.0 — no account, no network.
examples: Verify this hash against the APEX PSI ledger
skills.name: Verify a record

skills.description: Read the Bitcoin / OpenTimestamps anchoring state of a sealed receipt: whether its Merkle root has been committed to a real Bitcoin block, the block height and transaction id. An anchor counts only once a real block is found. Hosted tool: anchor_status. npm tool: anchor.
examples: Has this receipt been anchored to Bitcoin yet?
skills.name: Check anchoring

skills.description: Return a citable reference for a receipt: its identifier, ledger position and verification URL, in the form the protocol's citation page specifies (https://ai-governance-standard.com/cite). npm tool: cite.
examples: Give me the citation for receipt …
skills.name: Cite a receipt

skills.description: Check a whole agent run as one hash chain: mandate, proposal, decision and settlement records bound to a single run ID, each signed by its own party, verified as an unbroken chain including that the settled amount sits inside the mandate's limit and the deciding key is not the acting key (draft-singh-psi-agent-03). npm tool: verify_chain.
examples: Verify this agent run's chain end to end
skills.name: Verify an agent run chain
